title.narrative: UNICEF enhanced maternal, child, and adolescent health in Sri Lanka through revisions to care guidelines, provision of nutrition supplements, support to immunization programmes, and expansion of treatment for children with Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM). Key initiatives included local production of therapeutic food for SAM treatment, promotion of preschools as health settings, improvements in digital health, and stronger community engagement. These efforts significantly improved malnutrition rates, health data quality, and access to essential healthcare services.
